fields.Placement — Published: Official NIRF 2025 management pool: 202 of 230 graduates placed in 2023–24; 14 entered higher studies. Placed/all graduates = 87.83% (derived).
fields.Placement Scope: Official NIRF two-year management aggregate. General, Healthcare and Pharmaceutical MBA tracks are not separated.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Official/credible current listing confirms the management programme. These outcomes pool two-year management programmes and do not establish General MBA-specific mean or maximum.
